summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off) and a static render_speed(speed) that scales with filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and appends " it/s". Its render returns speed text for unknown totals when show_speed is on, using finished_speed or speed. Progress.track declares task_total as Optional[float] and leaves it None for unsized iterables instead of raising. The module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Added the CHANGELOG line and test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. Nothing was run, since tests, mypy, and black were not executed per instructions; blank-line checks by grep found no runs of three or more blank lines. Nothing was committed.
